questions.text:
Hi, it's Sage. Thank you so much for doing this 🙏
Every other week Mom leaves before sunrise and comes back the next night looking totally wrung out.
All she says is she has 'errands in the city.'
Which city does Mom keep driving to?

That's three hours each way 😟
She hates highway driving. She makes Dad drive even to Kearney.
Who is she going there to see?

That's way too high for someone sitting in a car 😟
Mom would rather pull her own tooth than make a fuss at a doctor's office.
If she's being treated in Omaha, I want to know where.
Which clinic is she going to in Omaha?

A hotel?? 😳
Okay. Maybe it's some outpatient thing and they make you stay over.
Dad only handles the equipment bills, so he'd never see the rest.
How much does she pay each time she stays there?

Same amount every time. Like clockwork.
Mom has eaten breakfast standing at the sink my whole life. Toast, coffee, out the door.
The morning after her most recent stay there, how many breakfasts did she order?

Two. Not one. Two 😶
Dad told me these trips are 'co-op business' and rolled his eyes like it's the most boring thing on earth.
What does she tell Dad she's doing in Omaha?

She really is the co-op treasurer, so maybe part of that's true.
She never takes time off. She worked the farm stand with a broken wrist once.
What did she take those Omaha days off as?

onboarding.text: My mom's been disappearing. Every other week she drives off before sunrise and comes home the next night looking like she hasn't slept. She says it's errands. I don't believe her, and I'm scared.
onboarding.label: Sage

onboarding.text: I'm Sage. I grew up on Bluestem Hollow, our lavender farm in Nebraska. Mom taught me to cut bundles before I could ride a bike. Every summer it was just us in the purple rows, laughing.
onboarding.label: Sage & Della

onboarding.text: That's Della, my mom. She runs the farm with Dad and keeps the books for the growers' co-op. She never complains, never slows down, never sees a doctor. Lately she gets winded just walking the rows.
onboarding.label: Della

onboarding.text: She dropped her phone in the field this morning, and the passcode is still my birthday. She's at the still until noon. Please help me find out what she's hiding before she comes back.
onboarding.label: Sage

msgs.text: Did Mom's new walker come? She says it squeaks.
Came Tuesday. I put WD-40 on the wheels 🙄
You're the best. I owe you.
Roy's retiring in March. Finally. He's already building a shed.
A shed for a man who's retiring from a shed? 😂
Exactly.
Can you send Grandma Kessling's kringle recipe again? My copy got jelly on it.
Sending a photo of the card now. Don't skip the cardamom.
Never. Thank you!
Sage says she's coming home for the summer. How are you feeling about it?
Over the moon. I'm washing every sheet in the house.
Happy birthday little sis!!! 50 looks great on you 🎉
Thank you!! Rhonda baked me a cake at 4am.
That woman is a national treasure.
Mom called me three times about the car title. Do you have it?
It's in the blue file at her house. Top drawer.
Found it. Thanks.
Denver had hail the size of golf balls. My hydrangeas are toast 😭
Oh no. We dodged one last week. Sorry, Mar.
I'll replant. Roy says it's an excuse to buy another shed.
Mom's knee appointment is the 18th of June. Can you drive her?
I can. I'll take the morning off the stand.
You always do. Thank you.
How did it go?
Fine. She complained about the parking, the gown and the doctor's shoes.
So, a good day 😂
Saw a lavender candle at the Denver farmers market. $38!! You're undercharging.
Don't give me ideas 😂
I'm serious. Do the math.
Roy and I want to drive out for the Lavender Festival. Is the guest room free?
Sage is in it, but the den has a pull-out. Or the couch, your pick.
Roy snores. Put us in the barn 😄
Harvest is in full swing. I smell like a candle shop.
Best smell on earth. Send a bundle with Sage when she visits.
Mom wants to know if you're coming up for her birthday. She won't ask you herself.
After the festival, I promise.
I'll tell her. She'll act like she doesn't care and then cry.
Sage is home!! She hugged me for a full minute.
Aw. Give her a squeeze from me.
How's the festival prep going? Need me to order anything?
Banners are done. Just the food vendors to confirm.
I promised Hank. After the festival I'm finally going to leave Gil.
Call me. Now.
Mom did you see the forecast?? Chicago is about to get buried
We got four inches last night. Dad already plowed the lane.
Of course he did 😂
He's out fixing the heater on the well pump now.
Tell him I said don't freeze
He says he's a Nebraskan, he doesn't freeze.
what goes in your minestrone again
Cannellini, kale, little tubetti pasta, rind of parmesan. Don't skip the rind.
the rind!! right
making a big pot for the whole week
Good. Eat something green.
I will, Mom 🥲
Work update: they put me on the library renovation
Sage! The one you liked?
the one I begged for 😳
I'm so proud. Tell me everything on our Sunday call.
Sunday call, yes. 4pm?
Make it 5. I'll be done with the goats by then.
Pearl got out again. Found her on the porch eating the geranium.
NOT the geranium 😭
Grandma's geranium??
Same one. It'll come back, they always do.
Pearl is a menace
She's your goat, you named her.
Mom do you remember what size my old boots were? I donated everything before I moved
Eight and a half. We'll get you new ones at Platte Valley.
you're the best
Just don't wear white ones, you'll ruin them in a day.
ok that was ONE time
Spring crates arrived, the lavender plugs look healthy
omg how many
Eight hundred. Your dad rented the transplanter again.
so he's happy
Delighted. He talks to it.
Mom. Rough day. Client meeting went badly
Do you want to call?
not yet. just wanted to tell someone
Okay. I'm here. Whenever.
you're always here ❤️
Always. Go to bed with a cup of tea.
I got the time off!! Whole summer, they said yes
Oh honey!!!
Your room is already waiting. Dad's moving the boxes out of it.
not the boxes of my drawings
Your drawings are safe. I'd never.
I'll fly out the first week of August
How are the rows looking?? Dad sent a blurry picture
Fat and purple. First cut should be good this year.
I can't wait to smell it
Bring a hat, the sun is mean.
Did you get my package? Sent you some tea from the shop on my block
Got it. The lemon-ginger one? Smells wonderful.
yes!! drink it before bed
Tonight.
Dad says Clover is limping
She got a thorn in her paw. The pet clinic got it out, she's fine.
poor girl 😟
She's sleeping on my feet as we speak.
Flight lands in Kearney at noon on August 1. Can Dad get me?
He'll be there with a sign.
please no sign
A big sign.
Mom what time does the farmers market need us set up? I want to bring the little chalkboard signs
Flight lands at 4:40 on Friday. Dad said he'd pick me up?
He'll be there. Wear something you can get dirty, Pearl has been in a mood 🐐
Haha Pearl always in a mood. Is Moxie still scared of the hose??
Terrified. Clover herds her away from it.
Can you make the sausage hash brown thing when I get there? I've been dreaming about it
Already on the list ❤️
landed!! I see Dad, he has a sign 😭
I told you.
Mom where are you, the kitchen smells like coffee but nobody's in it
Out at the still. There's a plate of muffins on the counter.
you're up at 5 even on my vacation
The lavender doesn't take vacations.
Do we still have my old bike in the barn? Want to ride out to the creek one morning
Gil pumped the tires yesterday. The seat is rusty but it works.
Perfect. I need to burn off the Chicago deep dish anyway 😅
Can I borrow the keys to the Ford? Want ice cream in town
Sage honey, can you grab the clothesline sheets before the rain?
On it!! Wind is wild out here
Thank you sweetheart. Supper at 7.
Welcome to the crew, everybody! This is where we'll sort out the farm event stuff
Hi all! Bev here with my notebook and a pen that works
Joanne reporting. I'll bring honey for the tasting table
Lena here. I can take the kids' craft table
Tom. Power, tents and anything that has a motor
You are all heroes. Meeting at the farm in two weeks?
Works for me
Same. I'll bring bars
Thanks for hosting yesterday! I made a list of what we decided
Great. Can you post it here?
Parking: Bev. Power and tents: Tom. Food: Bev and Wilma. Crafts: Lena. Tastings: Joanne. Cash box: Della
Looks right to me
Can we do name tags for volunteers? Last year no one knew who was in charge
Sage can make them. I'll ask her tonight
Sage is the best 💜
Anyone know if we need a permit for the small stage?
I called the county. It's only needed above a certain size, ours is fine
Good to know. Saves me a trip to the courthouse
I found glass jars for the lemonade at the thrift store, forty for ten dollars
Buy them all!!
Bought. I'll wash them this week
Does anyone have a good playlist for the day? Something not too loud
I'll put one together. Lots of Emmylou, a little Patty Griffin
Della's picks, of course 😄
We need to confirm rain plan. Tent stays up if it drizzles?
Yes. If it's lightning we pause everything and go inside the barn
Barn's swept. Gil and I moved the hay bales
Fantastic
Okay team, port-a-potty rental is confirmed. Two units by the parking field.
Thank goodness, that was last year's complaint number one.
Lemonade stand volunteers: I have six names so far!
I can do the 10 to 12 shift at the wreath table.
Perfect Lena. Della, are the wreath kits ready?
Almost! Drying racks are full but I'll have sixty by next week.
Reminder: next meetup is at the farm, 9 AM, bring your own coffee mug
Mug packed ☕
Bringing the honey samples and spoons
I'll bring the tape and the markers
See you all then. Thank you, truly
Weather says clear on the 15th so far 🤞
Don't jinx it Tom!!
Quick question, do we want a photo booth with a lavender arch?
Yes! Sage can handle the frame, she's the architect 😄
Sold 💜
I'll bring extra tarps just in case.
You all are wonderful. Thank you ❤️
Della, it's Roy. Marnie's birthday is coming up and I'm lost. Any ideas?
Hi Roy! She's been eyeing a good pair of garden clogs. Size 8, the dark green ones
Clogs. Got it. You're a genius
And write something in the card that isn't just 'love, Roy' 😉
Ha. I'll try. No promises
She loved the clogs. Wore them to bed. Thank you
Wore them to BED? 😂
Figure of speech. Mostly
Having the knee done on the 14th. Marnie's making me a spreadsheet of my own recovery
That sounds exactly like my sister. Do what the spreadsheet says
I do not have a choice
Thinking of you today, Roy. Gil says hang in there
Out of surgery, groggy but fine. Doctor says I'll be on the golf course by fall
You don't even golf!
I will now. Marnie signed me up for lessons. Apparently it's part of the plan
Walking to the mailbox today, a full forty steps. Feeling like Neil Armstrong
One small step for Roy 🙌
Question for you. What's that tea Marnie keeps saying you sent her? The lavender one?
Lavender-lemon balm blend. I'll mail you a tin
Appreciate it. She's been stressed about work and says it helps her sleep
Tin is in the mail. Put a little honey in it
Got it today. Smells like a hug
We're thinking about a fishing weekend at Lake McConaughy in September. Gil in?
I'll ask him. He's been grumbling about needing a break from the irrigation
Tell him I'll bring the good cooler
He says yes, as long as you promise not to talk about your knee for three days
Two days. Final offer
Deal 😂
Our AC died in the middle of the heat wave. 91 degrees in the kitchen
Oh no. Is there a repair guy coming?
Tomorrow morning. We're sleeping in the basement tonight like moles
Fixed! A capacitor, he said. Forty dollars part, two hundred for the visit
Classic
Della, Roy here. Can you tell Gil the combine part came in?
Will do, he's in the south field. Thanks Roy.
Marnie says hi and says to call her.
Tell her I will soon. Busy week.
Will do.
Heard Sage is home for the summer. That must be nice for you
Got a smoker to sell if you ever want to try brisket. Barely used.
Ha, ask Gil. That's his department.
Will do.
Cattle prices are up. Finally something good.
Glad to hear it.
It is. Five days now. The house feels full again
Good. Kids should come home. Ours never do
Your boys call you every Sunday, don't sell yourself short
For ninety seconds. Mostly to ask about Wi-Fi
😂 Take what you can get
Always do. Give Gil my best. Fishing in six weeks!
Market season starts in a few weeks! Are you taking the corner spot again?
Hope so. I put my application in with the market office.
They'll give it to you. You've had it forever.
Don't jinx it
Fine. Fingers crossed then 🤞
I got the stall next to yours!!
Yay! Honey and lavender, a perfect pair.
We should do a bundle. Honey + sachet for ten bucks?
Love it. I'll make little cards.
I'll bring ribbon
Packing the van for the first market. Do you need extra tables?
I have two. Gil's bringing the canopy.
Great. I have the sign you wanted printed.
You're an angel
Sold out of the lavender honey by noon!
Same with the soaps. The sachets nearly did too.
Whole town smells like you.
My back is killing me. Do you do anything for sore muscles?
Lavender and arnica salve, I'll bring a tin.
I'll pay you
No you won't.
Then I'm bringing you honey
There's a new guy selling kettle corn near the entrance. He's undercutting everybody
It's a big market, there's room.
You're too nice
I'm too tired to be anything else 😂
Heads up, the market office says water bottles can't be sold unless labeled. New rule.
Ugh. Thanks for the heads up. I'll check with them.
They said send a note by the end of the month
Did you see the new stall layout for the Kearney market? They moved us next to the kettle corn guy.
I saw. Smells wonderful but my oil sachets will smell like caramel 😂
Honestly people will buy more. Sweet smell, sweet purchase.
True. How did your honey sell last week?
Sold out by ten! Going to extract more this weekend.
Want to split a canopy weight order? Shipping is brutal for singles.
Yes! I need four. Send me the link.
Sent. I'll order tonight.
Did you see the weather? They say clear for the next market.
I saw. I'm still watching the radar like a hawk.
You and your hail
Once burned!
Honey for you at the stall, no arguments
Wind took my tent halfway across the lot yesterday. Never again without weights.
Oh no, is everyone okay?
Just my pride. And a jar of peach jam 😩
Bless. Weights arrive Thursday, I'll bring yours.
You're a peach. Pun intended.
Morning Della! Are you doing the early setup at the market again this season?
Hi Joanne. Not till the stalls open back up in April. Still too cold for the sachets to cure properly in the shed
Ha, my honey's frozen solid in the back room. Hoping for a warm March
Did you see the market office is raising booth fees again?
I saw the letter. Fifteen dollars more a season. Could be worse
Easy for you to say, you sell $18 oil bottles 😄
And it takes me six hours at the still for every batch. Trade you
No thanks!! I'll stick to my bees
Can I borrow your folding tables for the first market? Mine have a bad leg
Sure. Gil can drop them by if you're around
I'll swing by the farm this afternoon, save him the trip. Need anything from town?
A bag of chicken layer feed if you pass Platte Valley. I'll pay you back
Done. Don't you dare pay me back, you gave me that free lavender wand last year
First market of the year!! Look at this crowd already
I'm stuck behind a tractor on the county road. Save my spot!
Spot's saved. I put a jar of honey on it as a flag 🍯
Bless you
Sold out of the small lavender bundles by ten. People love them
Same with my honey sticks! Kids go crazy
Do you want to split a bigger tent for July? The heat on that pavement is brutal
Yes please. I'll look at prices tonight
Found one at Hy-Mart, 10x10 with sides. $139
Split is $70 each. Deal!
Thank you for covering my stall while I ran to the restroom. Pretty sure a man tried to haggle your oil down to $10 😂
He tried me last week too. Same guy, same hat
Hot one today. Bringing extra water, you want a cold lemonade?
Yes please, you're an angel
The new tent works great. Shade all day
Worth every penny. My feet thank you
Della, I found three more cases of those mason jars in the church basement. Want them for the festival?
Yes please! The lemonade station needs about thirty.
I'll have Ron drop them off Saturday.
Heard there's hail in the forecast for next week. You okay?
Checking the radar every ten minutes. Gil put the tarps over the nursery rows just in case
Praying it misses you. Let me know if you need hands
It passed north of us. Whole county exhaled
Thank goodness!! See you at the next market 🐝
I made a sign-up sheet for baked goods. Eleven people already!
Eleven! We'll need a bigger table.
Already on it. Ron has the sawhorses.
Do we want lavender shortbread or lemon-lavender bars as the featured treat?
Both! The shortbread sells out first though.
I'll make double shortbread then.
Printed the price cards. Cute little purple ones.
Love them. Thank you Joanne.
Anytime! Night night.
Oh, and bring Clover if you like. Kids will love her.
She'll be in her bandana 🐕
Hi Della! It's Lena. Are you still looking for help on Saturdays at the market?
Lena, yes! Seven to one, $15 an hour. Interested?
Very. I'm off classes at the community college on Saturdays
Wonderful. Starts the first Saturday in April. I'll show you the setup the week before
Awesome! Should I wear anything special?
Closed-toe shoes and a hat. Sun is no joke out there
Here early for setup! Where do I find the tent weights?
Blue bins in the back of the van. Four per corner
Got it. Wow these are heavy
You'll have forearms like a farmer by June
Great first day! We sold out of the soap bars before ten
You were wonderful with the customers. Thank you
Quick question, can I swap next Saturday for the one after? My cousin's confirmation
Sure, I'll ask Tom if he can cover. Congrats to your cousin
Thanks! I'll bring you cake
Tom's covering. You're all set
The card reader keeps saying 'offline'. What do I do?
Turn it off and on. Then hold your phone near the tent pole, signal's better there
That worked! You're a wizard
I've been doing this too long 😅
I finished my semester! Can I pick up extra hours this summer?
Yes please. I need hands in the field in July, cutting and bundling. Mornings, six to eleven
I can do that. Do I need gloves?
Gil has a box of leather ones in the shed. Take a pair that fits
First field morning done. I smell like a candle shop and I love it
That smell stays in your hair for days, fair warning
My mom said I smelled like a spa 😂
Running ten minutes late tomorrow. Flat tire
No worries. We'll start without you. Be safe
Ray's Auto fixed it for free. Said the patch was a quick one
Ray is a good egg
Do you want the drying racks cleaned today or tomorrow?
Today if you can. Hose them down and stack them by the barn door
On it
Della, did you get the email about the new label printer? Thought of you.
I saw it! Is it worth the price?
I bought one last month. Prints waterproof labels, game changer for my soap.
Okay, convinced. I'll order one.
Use my code, you get 10% off. I'll text it.
Got it, ordering tonight.
Your daughter is so nice! She helped me carry bundles and told me about Chicago
She's a talker when she's excited 🙂 Did she tell you about the river boats?
The architecture ones! I want to go now
You should. Save your paychecks
My dog ate a whole stick of butter today. He's fine, I'm just tired 😩
Oh no! Clover once ate a whole pie off the counter.
😂 dogs are the worst and the best
Printer arrived! Come see it Saturday.
Yay, will do.
I'm trying! Same hours Friday?
Same hours. See you at six
Pivot 2 is throwing a fault again. Gonna swap the sensor tomorrow.
Ok. Supper's at 6:30, leftover chili.
Happy Valentine's. Left something on the counter.
Found it. Chocolate and the good pliers? 😂
Both are romantic.
Pearl got out again. Can you check the fence by the shed?
On it.
Found the gap. Fixed. She looked real proud of herself.
Ray's has the tires. $212 for the pair. Ok to buy?
Yes go ahead.
Did you eat? There's soup on the stove.
Eating at the shop. Bearing's shot on the transfer pump.
Sage called. She might come home for the summer!
Good. Too quiet around here.
Frost warning tonight. Cover the new rows?
Already got the row cover out. Help me at noon?
Noon. Bringing the staple gun.
Happy birthday, Del. Dinner at the Pizza Barn tonight? My treat.
Yes! 6:30. You're sweet.
Board meeting in Calder tonight, back by 9. Plate's in the oven.
Got it. Don't let Walt talk your ear off.
Too late 😩 he brought a slideshow.
Hail on the radar west of Elm Creek. Moving the truck under the lean-to.
Please. And close the still room door!
Missed us. Hail went north.
Thank God. 🙏
Who's feeding the girls tonight? I'm stuck at the parts store.
I'll do it. Get the drip line fittings too.
Already in the cart.
Farmers market tomorrow. Can you load the truck tonight?
Loading now. How many crates of sachets?
Six. And the tent weights.
Heading out early, the co-op audit runs late, staying over.
Ok. Drive safe.
Made it. Call you tomorrow night.
Clover misses you. She's on your side of the bed.
Home soon. Leaving now.
Still room is at 170 degrees. Don't touch the valve, I'll handle it.
Thanks. I'll stay out of your way 😄
Co-op audit again, back tomorrow night. Pearl's grain is in the blue bin.
Blue bin. Got it.
Moxie ate your hat. Sorry.
The orange one?? 😂
The orange one.
Harvest crew starts Monday. Need me at the field at 6?
Yes please. First cut is the east block.
Leaving at 5. Co-op audit, staying over. Back tomorrow.
Ok.
Crew finished the west block. 40 bundles hanging.
Wonderful. Thank you for handling it 💜
Pump 3 is making that noise again.
Call Tom at Kearney Tractor, he said he'd come out.
Called. He's coming Thursday.
Need anything from town?
Coffee filters and stamps. Thanks.
The co-op audit is running long again, staying over.
Again? They work you too hard.
I know. Tomorrow afternoon I'll be home.
Ok.
Clover threw up on the porch. She's fine now.
Poor girl. Give her some rice.
Festival tent people called. They want the deposit by next week.
I'll mail the check tomorrow.
Can you cover the farm August 27 to 30? Girls' trip with Rhonda, Black Hills.
Didn't know you and Rhonda were doing a trip.
It came together fast.
I'll cover it.
Sage is almost to the driveway. Come say hi.
Be right there.
Fed the girls. Clover's fine.
Thanks.
Good morning Della. Did Gil's cold clear up?
Mostly. He's still coughing but he's out in the shop.
That boy never rests. Tell him to take the honey.
I will. How's the hip?
Therapy says it's coming along. I walked to the mailbox and back.
That's wonderful, Carol!
Don't get excited. It took twenty minutes.
I'd like to put in an order for the sachets again. For the church sale.
How many?
Two dozen. The ladies loved them last year.
I'll have them ready and bring them Sunday.
You're a dear.
Happy Palm Sunday. Will you come for dinner after service? I'm making ham.
We'd love to. Is one o'clock okay? Gil has the irrigation to check first.
One is fine.
Bring that pickled beet thing
Will do.
Carol, did you get my voicemail about the tomato starts?
I did. My phone does not like me. I'll take six.
Brandywine and Early Girl, mixed?
Whatever you think. Last year's were too sour.
Then Early Girl and a couple of the sweet cherry ones.
Pastor Reuter asked about you. I said you're busy with the farm.
Tell him I'll come when the cut is done.
He understands.
I fell on the step. I'm fine, don't tell Gil yet
Carol! Are you hurt?
Bruised pride. Mrs. Voss next door helped me up.
I'm coming over this afternoon. And I'm telling Gil, it's not a secret.
You are as stubborn as he is.
I learned from the best.
Thank you for the visit and the soup. I'm still thinking about that cornbread.
I'll send you the recipe.
Write it big. My eyes.
I'll write it huge.
Is Sage coming soon? I have a gift for her.
This week. She's staying all summer.
Good. A girl should be home in the summer.
Della, are you bringing the green bean thing to the church potluck?
I can. Do you need the casserole dish back too?
Keep it till then, I have six others 😂
Gil's mother's recipe, so I'm told. Which I never actually saw written down.
Ha. She'd never write it down. It was all 'a little of this'.
My knee is acting up again. Might skip the walk Saturday.
Rest it. I'll bring you some lavender salve, it's the arnica one.
You spoil me. Is Sage home yet?
Landed this afternoon. Tall as ever and thin as a rail.
Give her a hug from her aunt Carol. Tell her I have her cinnamon rolls.
She'll be over before you know it 🙂
Send her my love. And tell her I knitted the scarf. Too early, I know.
She'll love it. I'll tell her.
Saw on the news there's hail possible tonight. Cover your lavender!
Checking the radar every ten minutes. Gil has the row covers ready.
Praying it goes around you.
Thank you Carol. Talk soon.
Love you both.
Aunt Della!! We had the ultrasound. It's twins!!
Maddie!!! Two babies?!
Two. Mom nearly fainted in the parking lot
I can imagine. Congratulations sweetheart, I'm over the moon.
Keep it quiet until we tell Trevor's parents
My lips are sealed.
Do you know anything good for morning sickness?
Ginger tea, and crackers before you get out of bed. Peppermint oil on a tissue.
Lavender?
Lavender helps you sleep, peppermint for the nausea. I'll mail you some.
Thank you!!
Mom wants to throw the shower at the farm in July. Is that too much to ask?
Not at all. I'd love it. The porch has shade after four.
Perfect. I'll let Mom know, she'll make a spreadsheet
😂 she's been making spreadsheets since we were girls
Doctor says one is a little smaller. They're watching.
Thinking of you. Is Trevor taking time off?
He's trying. His boss is great about it
Good. You need help.
Mom offered to move in for a month after 😅
Then let her. Take every hand that's offered.
Names!! Do you like Wren and Theo?
Wren is lovely. I like Theo too.
Trevor says Theo sounds like a dentist
Dentists are fine people.
Can't sleep. I'm huge. I keep waking up
Pillow between your knees. And I'll send the lavender pillow spray.
Please
In the mail today.
The shower was perfect!! Everyone's still talking about the pie.
So glad. Your mother outdid herself.
We got eleven onesies. ELEVEN.
You'll need them all.
Hi Miss Della! Mom said you need help bagging sachets for the festival?
I do, Maddie! Would you have a couple afternoons next week?
Yes! I'm off school stuff all week. Same pay as last year?
A little more, you've earned it. Come Tuesday at one.
Yay!! Can I bring my speaker?
As long as it's not that loud screaming music 😄
Promise. Mostly country. Mom's rubbing off on me lol
Hospital bag is packed. I think.
Put in your own pillow and thick socks. Hospitals are cold.
Noted!!
Tell Sage welcome home from us
I will.
Is Sage back? I want to ask about college architecture stuff
She's here. She'd love to chat. Come by tomorrow if you like.
Omg yes thank you!!
Bring me a sachet when you come by?
I'll bring three.
Can I pet the goats too?
Moxie will insist on it.
See you tomorrow sweetie.
Hi Della, did the May minutes go out? Walt is asking.
Sent them last night. Check your inbox.
Got them. Thank you!
Stipend deposits went out this morning.
Saw it land. Thanks Lorna 🙂

Great Plains Health: Your flu shot clinic opens in September. Walk-ins welcome at the Kearney campus.
Is the lab open early on the 12th? I need to be done by 8:30.
Yes, lab opens at 7:00 AM. You'll be fine.
Thank you.
Great Plains Health: Please call to schedule your flu shot appointment this fall. Reply STOP to opt out.
RevoBank: Your verification code is 482916. It expires in 10 minutes. Never share this code.
RevoBank: Your verification code is 705338. It expires in 10 minutes. Never share this code.
Del, did you get the hotdish dish back to the Bodines? I can drop it off.
I'll take it over myself tonight. That poor man.
Okay good. You're a good friend, Del.
Maddie's scan is today!! Twins!! 😭
WHAT. Two babies?? Rhonda!!
Two. I need to sit down.
I'm bringing you shortbread tomorrow. Lavender, obviously.
Save me the broken pieces 🤤
The oven at the Rolling Pin died. Sunday cinnamon rolls are cancelled 😩
Use mine. Come over, I'm up anyway.
You're a lifesaver. Bringing the dough in a cooler.
Co-op meeting was a snooze. Walt did slides again.
I took notes in the margins. Mostly doodles of Walt's tie.
😂😂 send me a picture
Do you remember the name of that goat lotion you made last year?
Pearl's Balm. I'll bring a jar Saturday.
Sage is coming home for the summer, you know.
I know, you've told me four times 😄 so happy for you.
Happy birthday to my oldest friend!! 50!! I'm not crying you're crying 🎂
Don't remind me 😭 Gil's taking me to the Barn.
Wear the green dress. I left a cake on your porch.
RHONDA. It's a three-layer. When did you even bake this?
4am. Don't tell my cardiologist.
You don't have a cardiologist 😂
I will after that cake.
Hail warning!! Are your rows covered?
Gil's on it. It went north. 🙏
Thank God. Maddie says her feet are the size of loaves.
Haha. Tell her to elevate. I'll send salts.
Are you doing the farmers market Saturday? I'll bring scones for your stand.
Yes. Set up at 7. You're an angel.
Sold out by 10. Your sachets and my scones, a power couple.
We should go into business 😂
Doc texted you yet? 😏
Rhonda. Hush.
Did you hide that photo of you two like I told you?
Done. Locked it with his birthday. Gil would never guess that one.
Good. Phones are nosy things.
Maddie's due date moved up. Any day now!!
Keep your phone loud. I'll come running with casserole.
Harvest crew okay this year?
Best crew in years. Gil's holding the pumps together with tape.
Omaha again? Tell Doc I said hi 😏
Shh. Doc says hi back.
Be careful, Del. I mean it.
I will. Love you.
Told Gil it's you and me in the Black Hills at the end of August.
Don't you dare put me in the middle of that trip.
I know. I'm sorry.
Is Sage settling in? Bring her by the bakery, I owe her a hug.
Will do. She's already reorganized my spice shelf.
Clover's limping on the left hind again. Want me to swing by with the truck?
Not today. Gil's around the yard till noon. Tomorrow after the market?
Tomorrow works. I'll bring the good wrap.
Thank you for the soup, by the way. Ate it standing over the pot like a bachelor.
You ARE a bachelor. Eat at the table, Hank.
Yes ma'am 🙂
I'm asking you to move in with me, Del. The ridge house has been too quiet for three years.
Hank. I read that three times. I can't answer it tonight.
I'm not asking for tonight. I'm asking for when you're ready. I'll wait.
Go to sleep. Love you.
Love you too. Sleep.
Heifer in the south pasture is down, got a call. Phone will be on.
Be careful out there. Text me when you're done.
She's up. Calf's fine. Home for coffee.
Say it to Marnie the way you said it to me tonight. Then it's real.
I know. I'm doing it now.
I'm right here. Whatever she says.
Anyone know if the Kearney market is open the morning of the festival? Trying to figure out my schedule
I think they close early for it every year, around ten
Yes, I got that email. Booths have to be packed by 10:30
Thanks Della!
Booth map is posted on the fridge in the barn office. Please don't move the stakes!
Do we need our own tables or are you providing?
Tables yes, canopies no. Bring your own shade.
I'm bringing honey and the beeswax candles. Can I have the spot by the goats?
Goat corner is Wilma's, sorry Bev. You're by the still tour sign.
Fine by me, I'll have the shortbread cookies 🍪
Someone left a folding table at my stall last week. Pretty sure it's one of ours
That's mine, Tom! Sorry. Can I grab it Saturday?
Sure, I'll set it aside
Reminder that we split the tent fee for the heat spell. Venmo me ten bucks each
Sent ✔️
Sent too, thanks Joanne
Parking: Tom's directing cars off County Road. Orange vests please.
I have vests. Eight of them. Don't ask.
Hail in the forecast for next week 😬 Anyone have a backup plan?
Barn is the backup. Fingers crossed it doesn't come to that.
Okay team, welcome to the festival group! This is where we sort out booths, parking, and who is bringing what.
Yay! Happy to help with whatever. Just keep me off the heavy lifting, doctor's orders 🤰
Maddie you just sit and be adorable. We've got you
I can run the sachet table again. Same as last year?
Yes please Ellen. You're a natural
I'll handle parking. Cliff and I will put the orange cones out in the field by the road
Roger that. I'll bring the tractor and the hay wagon for rides
Kids will go nuts for the wagon rides
Who's doing food? Last year the lemonade ran out by noon
I'm making lavender lemonade and shortbread. Janelle, could you do the pulled pork sandwiches?
Sure thing. I'll borrow the church roaster
I can do cookies and brownies. Store-bought is frowned upon 😂
Frowned upon but nobody will know if you scuff the box
Cliff!! 😂
Port-a-potties are booked. Four of them, with a hand-wash station
Thank goodness. Last year's line was a nightmare
We need signs for the parking field. Does anyone have a good marker and some cardboard?
I've got paint and plywood scraps. I'll make them this weekend
You're the best. Make the arrows big
My nephew plays fiddle. Would you want live music on the porch for an hour?
Oh I would love that. What time works for him?
He said early afternoon, around one. He'll bring a friend on guitar
Done and done. Tell him lemonade is on the house
Cash box question: who is making change at the gate?
I'll set up a bank bag with small bills the day before
Maddie can sit at the gate with the cash box, shady chair, no lifting 😄
Deal. I'll bring a cooler of water and my own pillow
Weather says 40% chance of storms. Anyone have extra tarps?
Gil has about six in the barn. I'll ask him
I'll bring some folding tables too. Church has a bunch
Please tell me we're ordering the t-shirts this year
Ordered! Soft purple with the little sprig logo. They arrive next week
I want a large so it's comfy 😅
I've got your sizes on the list, Maddie. Extra-large, just in case the twins sprout early
Ha! You know me too well
Reminder to everyone: park in the field, not in the lane. Last year somebody blocked the delivery truck
Noted. Big sign at the road too
Thank you all, truly. This wouldn't happen without you 💜
Radar shows a line building out west of Kearney. Could be hail by 6.
Thanks Tom. Pulling the tractor into the shed.
I can see it from my porch, sky is green at the edges. That's never good.
Green sky means bring in the laundry and the dog.
Covering the young plants with row cloth now. Wind's picking up fast.
Dime-size hail in town, hitting the Hy-Mart lot.
Pea-size at our place so far. Fingers crossed it stays that way.
Power just flickered at my house.
All clear on the west side. It's moving east. Everyone okay?
All good here. Lost a trash can lid and that's it.
Fine here too. Thank you for the heads up Tom, you saved my seedlings.
Anytime. Group's here for a reason!
Anyone know if the county road by the Ott place is washed out? Heard there's water over it.
Drove it an hour ago, it's passable but go slow. Gravel's soft.
Thanks Roy. Hauling a trailer so I'll take the long way around.
Reminder the siren test is at noon tomorrow. Don't panic if you hear it.
Thanks Wilma. Last time my border collie hid under the bed for an hour 😅
Clover's got good sense.
Heads up, NWS has a severe thunderstorm watch for Buffalo County until 10 tonight.
Got it. Moving the goats to the barn and latching the chicken coop.
Quarter-size hail reported near Gibbon. Heading our way.
Everybody get inside and stay safe. Check in when it passes.
Della, got a minute? Customer in Lincoln wants forty of the small sachets by the end of the month
Sure. I can do that. How are they paying?
Invoice. Net 15. I'll email you the PO
Sounds good. Do they want the boxed set or loose?
Boxed, with the kraft labels
Okay. I'll need a few days to print more labels
No rush. Thanks as always
Labels came out great. Dropping the boxes at your shop tomorrow morning
Perfect. I'll be there until noon
Customer loved them. She wants to reorder for the holidays
Wonderful! I'll start a note on the fall calendar
Mrs. B, crew is at row 14 by 6. Want us to do the Munstead block first?
Yes, Munstead first. It's ready before the heat.
Two of the kids need rides home today. Okay if I take the farm truck?
Take it. Just bring it back with gas in it.
Always 👍
Bundles are drying in the barn, 40 so far. Fans are on.
Perfect. Thank you, Teo.
Welcome all. I made this group so we can stop reply-all-ing on email. Board stuff only, please.
Thank you Walt. Much easier to keep up with on my phone
Reminder that the shared truck needs an oil change before the June haul
I'll call Ray's Auto this week and get it on their schedule
Thanks Della. Lorna, can you send the member dues sheet when you get a chance?
Sending it tonight. A few members are still behind on spring dues
I can follow up with those folks personally
Appreciate it Marcy. Gentle nudge only, nobody wants a fuss
Truck is booked for Thursday morning at Ray's. Should be done by lunch
Great, thanks Della 👍
Is the coffee urn at the hall still broken? Or did someone fix it?
Ron took it home to look at. I think the heating coil is gone
Coil is gone. New urn is forty dollars at the farm supply. I'll expense it?
Go ahead, Ron. Save the receipt and give it to Della
Will do. Photo of the receipt is fine, Ron
Hey folks, we have a new member application from the Hendricks place near Gibbon. Sunflowers and honey.
Honey would be a nice addition to the market stand
I'm all for it. We can vote at the next meeting
Seconded. Does she have liability insurance? Last time we skipped that step
Good catch, Barb. I'll ask for the certificate before the vote
Market stall fees went up by ten dollars for next season. Just got the notice from the office
Ugh. Of course they did
We can absorb it for now. Let's revisit at the fall meeting
Agreed. I'll put it on the agenda
Anyone have a spare pop-up tent for the festival? Ours has a rip
Co-op tent is in the shed at my place, Marcy. Come get it any time
Perfect, I'll swing by after church
Reminder: board meeting is at the Lutheran hall, 7 PM next Tuesday. Pie provided by Barb.
Rhubarb, don't tell anyone 🤫
I'll bring the budget printouts. Short version: we're fine
Those are the best four words a treasurer can say 😂
Ray's called. Truck is ready for pickup. Total came to under what they quoted
Miracles happen
New member vote passed 5 to 0. I'll send the welcome packet to the Hendricks woman
Welcome aboard! I'll call her about the market stall
Forecast shows storms on the 15th. Fingers crossed it clears for the festival
I check it six times a day. We'll have canopies ready just in case
We've weathered worse. See you all there 🌿
Della, honey, did the casserole dish come back to you? I can't find my blue Pyrex
I think it's in my cupboard from Easter. I'll bring it next time I come by
No rush. Gil called yesterday, said the tomatoes were coming in early
They are. We'll have more than we can eat. I'll send a box with him
That would be lovely. How's the lavender looking?
Best bloom in years. Cutting starts next week
Praise the Lord. Your dad always said it'd take a few years to take off, and he'd be so proud
Thank you Carol. That means a lot
My knee is acting up again. The doctor wants me to do those exercises with the rubber band
Are you doing them?
Sometimes. Maybe. When I remember
Carol 😂 Set an alarm on your phone. I'll text you a reminder every morning if I have to
That won't be necessary. I'll do them. Mostly
Church ladies are doing a quilt raffle for the roof fund. Would you donate a lavender basket?
Of course. Soap, sachets, and a small oil bottle. I'll drop it off before the end of the month
You're a blessing. I'll tell Pastor
Happy Fourth of July! Did you do fireworks?
Gil set off some sparklers with the neighbors. Clover hid under the porch the entire night
Poor baby. Pepper used to do the same thing
I heard Sage is coming for the summer. Is that so?
Yes! Beginning of August. I'm over the moon
Tell her Grandma Carol has a drawer full of her old drawings. She can have them
She'll love that. She drew houses for everything, remember? Even the chicken coop
With a little balcony 😂 I always knew she'd be an architect
The pharmacy messed up my prescription again. They gave me the wrong strength
Oh no. Did you take any?
No, I caught it. I'm going back this afternoon to have it fixed
Good catch. I can drive you if you want. I'm headed to Hy-Mart anyway
Would you? Gil already offered but he's busy with the irrigation. Around three?
Three is good. I'll be at your door
Thank you for lunch today. That soup was just right
Anytime, Carol. Rest that knee
Are you all coming for Sunday dinner when Sage is here? I'll make my pot roast
Wouldn't miss it. Sage has been asking for your pot roast since Christmas
Then it's settled. Tell Gil to bring his appetite
He always does 😊
Love you, Della. You're the daughter I never had
Love you too, Carol. Get some rest
Platte Valley Farm Supply: Hi Della, your special order of 24 cases of 4 oz amber bottle shipping cartons is in. Pickup at the counter any time.
Thank you! Gil will swing by this afternoon with the flatbed.
Sounds good. Reminder we close at 5:30.
Platte Valley Farm Supply: Poultry feed is on sale this week, 50 lb layer pellets $17.99. Stop in or reply to reserve.
Please hold 4 bags for me. I'll be in tomorrow morning.
Held under Brandvold. See you then.
Do you carry the little hose repair couplings, 5/8 inch? Gil's drip line sprung a leak in the north rows.
We have them in brass and plastic. Brass is $4.25 each. How many do you need?
Ten of the brass, please. And a roll of the green tape.
Got it, bagged at the counter.
Platte Valley Farm Supply: Fly spray and goat mineral are back in stock.
Perfect timing, the girls are out of mineral. Two bags please.
Two bags set aside. Thanks Della!
Sage will pick them up, she's driving in for ice cream anyway 😄
Morning! Did you see the hens at the fair got blue ribbons? Mine didn't 🙄
Ha! Yours are better layers than any of those show birds.
That's what I told them. Hey, want to swap? I've got a dozen eggs with your name on them, you've got that goat milk soap recipe.
Deal. It's mostly lye safety and patience. I'll write it out.
Gloves, goggles, no kids in the kitchen. I remember from the last time you told me 😂
Good student. Pearl gives about a quart a day right now, more than I can use.
I'll take milk too if you're pouring it out. Cliff wants to try cheese.
Bring jars Thursday and I'll fill them.
Jars are washed and waiting. Thank you friend.
Della!! The soap came out of the mold and it's CREAMY. Look at me, a soap maker.
Told you. How long is it curing?
Four weeks they say. I keep poking it.
Stop poking 😄 Leave it on a rack with air all around.
Fine. Are you coming to church supper? Lutheran ladies are doing the ham and scalloped potatoes.
I'll bring a pan of bars. Gil's got a pump to fix.
Bars are always welcome. Save me one of the lemon ones.
Weather app says hail possible tonight. I'm covering the seedlings.
Same. I've been refreshing the radar all evening. My nerves.
It's going north of us I think. Keep your fingers crossed.
Crossed and then some. Night Ellen.
Maddie's ultrasound was this morning. Both babies are measuring right on track 😭
Oh Rhonda!! I'm so happy for you all. Is she feeling okay?
Tired and cranky and craving pickles. Typical. Her doctor says she'll probably deliver early with twins
That's normal with twins. Sage came two weeks early and she was one. You'll be fine.
I need to start knitting. Do you still have that blanket pattern with the little scallops?
It's in the cedar chest. I'll dig it out and take a picture of it next time I'm in the house in daylight
You're a lifesaver. Are you coming to the co-op potluck?
Walt asked me to bring my lavender shortbread. Again.
Because it's the best thing on the table and he knows it 😂
Do you want to split a booth at the Kearney market this month? Mine is too big for just my jams
Sure, I'll take the back half. I'll bring the sachets and you keep the front for jam
Deal. Bring your tablecloth, mine has a gravy stain from Easter
The still is making that clunking sound again. Gil says it's the pump. I say it's haunted.
Haunted by the ghost of Bart Ferrin and his terrible welding 😂
Hail warning on my phone again. I've got the tarps out on the north rows
Same here, the radar looks nasty out toward Gibbon. Stay inside!
Missed us completely. Not one stone. I could cry
Thank the Lord. Mine got pea-size on the garden but the tomatoes survived
Can you pick up some of that good mustard at Hy-Mart if you go? The grainy kind
I'm there this afternoon. Anything else?
Diapers. I'm kidding. Mostly. Maddie wants me to start buying in bulk 🙄
Got your mustard. I'll leave it in your mailbox on my way home
You're an angel. Wanna do coffee tomorrow morning before the heat?
Can't tomorrow, I've got a batch running until noon. Day after?
Day after works. The diner at 7?
Perfect. I'm going to order the pie for breakfast and not feel guilty
Maddie picked names. Lucy and Jack. What do you think?
Lucy and Jack. I love it. Those are real farm kid names
I'm putting you down as honorary Aunt Della on the shower invite, hope that's okay
I'd be honored. When is it?
The 22nd of August at the Lutheran fellowship hall. I'll text you the details
Marking it on the calendar now. I'll make the lavender lemonade
Yes!! Maddie will want a gallon just for herself
Pearl got out again and ate half of Gil's tomato plants. He is not speaking to her
😂😂 Good for Pearl. Tell Gil goats don't read the signs
Sage is flying in soon, I've got the guest room smelling like a lavender sachet factory
She'll love that. Give her a big hug from me. Is she staying the whole summer?
Till after the festival at least. I'm trying not to hover 🥲
Hi Della! It's Maddie. Mom said you might have extra dried lavender for the shower favors?
Hi honey! I sure do. How many favors are you making?
Probably 40? Little muslin bags with a ribbon. Is that too many??
Not at all, people always take two. I'll bag up enough for 50 and you can keep the leftovers for your drawers.
You're the best. What do I owe you?
Nothing. It's a gift for the babies. Two of them, I can't believe it 🥹
I know!! My feet are already the size of canoes
Elevate them and drink water. I'll drop the bags at your mom's on my way to the market.
Perfect. Thank you thank you
Della, the favors are SO pretty. Everybody keeps smelling them 😍
Oh good! How did the shower go?
So good. Got two of everything, even two car seats. Mom cried at the cake.
That sounds like Rhonda 😄 Did you find a name yet?
We're stuck between two sets. I'll tell you when we decide. Don't tell Mom I told you there's a short list.
My lips are sealed.
Hey, do you still have that recipe for the lavender shortbread? Mom wants me to bring some to the hospital bag snack stash 😂
Ha! Yes. Two sticks butter, half cup sugar, two cups flour, and a tablespoon of dried buds ground fine. 325 until just golden.
Ground fine, got it. I always put in too many buds and it tastes like soap
Everybody does the first time. Less is more with lavender.
Thank you!! Love you Della ❤️
Making this group so we can plan the family get-together without 40 separate texts 😂
Good call, Marnie. Roy is going to bring his smoker
Yay!! Is it going to be at the farm?
Hi sweetheart, glad you're in here. Yes, Della said the farm after the heat breaks
I can make my potato salad with the bacon
Mom's potato salad, yes please
Della! Didn't know you were lurking 😂
I'm always lurking. Somebody has to keep you out of trouble
Roy wants to know if you have a spot for his smoker that's not under the oak tree
Back of the barn near the gravel. Plenty of room and no sparks near the hay
Perfect. I'll bring twenty pounds of brisket
Twenty?? Roy there are 12 of us
Leftovers are the best part, Marn
Okay okay fair 😂
Can we do the cornhole tournament again? Winner picks the movie on the porch
Absolutely. Grandma Carol is defending champion
I have been practicing in the back yard with a shoebox
Carol with a shoebox. The competition is shaking
We need a date. Gil's got a window after the second cutting
How about the weekend after Sage lands? Everyone will be around
Works for me. I can be there by noon
Perfect. I'll make a couple of pies
Mom, can you do peach cobbler too? Sage asked specifically
Two desserts! I'm not complaining
Marnie, Roy, do you want to stay overnight? We have the guest room and the pull-out
We'd love to. Roy snores but he'll behave
I do not snore
Roy you shook the windows last Thanksgiving
Dad says he'll pick up ice and charcoal the day before
Tell Gil thanks. Roy will pay him back
Do we need to bring chairs?
We've got folding chairs from the festival stash. Just bring yourselves
I land the first of August!! Cannot wait to see everyone 🥲
We can't wait either, sweetie. Auntie Marnie is bringing you something from Denver
Ooh what is it??
If I tell you it won't be a surprise
Fine. I'll be patient. (I won't.)
Mom's 80th is in October! Who's bringing the potato salad?
Not me. Last time I got a lecture about the mustard.
I'll do it. Same recipe, less mustard 😂
Dana, can you book the church hall? Pastor said the fellowship room is open.
On it. Will call the office tomorrow.
Found the old photo of Grandpa's Buick. Sending now.
Look at those fins!! 😍
Roy wants one for the new shed. I told him no.
Mom!! Just got the Kearney flight options. Can't do the 1st, work thing. Probably the 1st of August or the 2nd?
Whatever works for you, sweetheart. Dad will pick you up either way
Okay. I'm taking the whole month off, maybe longer. The firm said I can work remote part of it
That is the best news I've had all year!
Is the old blue bike still in the barn? I want to ride to the bridge like when I was little
Somewhere behind the feed bins. The tires are flat but Dad can fix them
Perfect 😂 I'm going to need my old straw hat too
I'll find it. Did you see the photos I sent of the first bloom?
YES. I made it my phone wallpaper. The purple is unreal
My building project got approved!! The library annex. I'm lead on the facade
Sage!!! I'm so proud of you. Tell me everything
It's brick and glass, very Midwest. Lots of meetings but I love it. I'll show you drawings when I'm home
Dad is already bragging to everyone at the feed store
Of course he is 🥲 Tell him I said hi
How's the heat there? It's been a hundred and two in the shade here
Chicago is soup. My apartment AC is on its last legs
Come home early, then. The farmhouse has the good fans
Tempting. I'll see what I can do 😅
Do you want me to make the peach cobbler when you get here?
Mom. Yes. Obviously yes
Then I'll need to get peaches at the Saturday market. I'll hold back a dozen
Don't hold back, buy ALL the peaches
Do you remember Clover as a puppy? She chewed through your whole sandal collection
She ate my favorite pair of boots!! I cried for a day
Now she just sleeps on the porch and judges the chickens
I miss her so much 💔 Send a photo of her face
Just sent it. She's got a little more gray on her chin now
Aww. Same, Clover. Same.
Okay, my ticket is booked. Landing in Kearney in the afternoon on the 1st
Wonderful. I'll have supper waiting
Can I have the chicken and dumplings? The real kind, not the Chicago kind
Chicken and dumplings it is. And buttermilk biscuits
I'm going to gain ten pounds this summer and I don't even care 😂
Packing is a mess. Do I need real boots or are sneakers okay for the rows?
Boots. Always boots. We have snakes this year
Mom!!! 😳 You didn't tell me that
Just a few garter snakes. Mostly they're scared of you
Okay. Boots. Bringing boots. Love you, see you soon ❤️
Hi Della, Kyle here. Your 2 oz amber order shipped this morning
Thanks Kyle! Tracking number?
Sent to your email just now
Got it. Last time two cases arrived cracked. Can you pad the boxes a bit more?
Absolutely. I'll double the paper on this one and flag it for the warehouse
Appreciate that
Hi Della, Kyle at Glassworks. Your 2 oz amber bottles shipped this morning, 12 cases.
Great, thanks Kyle. Need them before the festival.
Tracking says they land in two days. Droppers are on backorder, though.
How backordered?
About ten days. I can send the metal-cap ones as a swap.
Send the metal caps. Customers won't mind.
Done. Invoice coming by email.
Boxes arrived today, all intact. Thank you!
Great to hear. Do you want to lock in your fall price on droppers before it goes up?
Send me a quote and I'll take it to the co-op
Will do by end of day

notes.title: Shortbread — lavender
notes.body:
Gran's shortbread, tweaked for market samples

1 cup butter, soft
1/2 cup powdered sugar
1 tbsp culinary buds, ground fine in the spice mill (NOT the still-room one)
1 tsp vanilla
1/4 tsp salt
1 3/4 cups flour

Beat butter + sugar, add the rest. Roll in a log, chill an hour. Slice, bake 325 for 15-18 min until the edges barely color.

Too much lavender = soap. Stick with 1 tbsp.
Try brown butter next batch? Ask Bev Osterhaus how she does hers.
